regulations.name: IEC 60601-1 Medical Electrical Equipment General Requirements
EN 60601-1 Medical Electrical Equipment General Requirements

tests.name: Static Load Test - Foot Rest Standing Patient/Operator
tests.description: PATIENT support/suspension system positioned horizontally in most disadvantageous position in NORMAL USE; mass 2 x 135 kg or twice intended persons load (greater used) applied to foot support over area of 0.1 m2 for 1 min
acceptance_criteria: Damage or deflection greater than 5° from normal did not occur
BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE was maintained

tests.name: Static Load Test - Sitting Support/Suspension
tests.description: PATIENT support/suspension system set in most unfavourable NORMAL USE position; mass of 60% of part of SAFE WORKING LOAD simulating PATIENT or OPERATOR, or minimum 80 kg, placed on support or suspension system with centre of load 60 mm from outer edge for at least 1 min
acceptance_criteria: Deflection of support/suspension from normal greater than 5° did not occur
BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE was maintained

tests.name: Dynamic Force Test - Patient/Operator Support/Suspension
tests.description: PATIENT support/suspension system set in most unfavourable NORMAL USE position; mass equal to SAFE WORKING LOAD simulating PATIENT or OPERATOR dropped from 150 mm above seat area on an area of support/suspension a PATIENT or OPERATOR can sit
acceptance_criteria: BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE maintained

tests.name: Mechanical Protective Device Functional Test
tests.description: Compliance confirmed by examination of ME EQUIPMENT over travel calculations and evaluation plus functional tests

requirements.description: Part of SAFE WORKING LOAD representing mass of ACCESSORIES deployed as in NORMAL USE and, when not defined, at worst case position permitted by configuration or ACCESSORIES attachment on support/suspension parts
Entire mass of PATIENT or OPERATOR distributed over an area of 0.1 m2 on a foot rest temporarily supporting a standing PATIENT or OPERATOR
Deflection of a support surface from PATIENT or OPERATOR loading on an area of support/suspension where a PATIENT or OPERATOR can sit did not result in an unacceptable RISK
Dynamic forces that can be exerted on equipment parts supporting or suspending a PATIENT or OPERATOR in NORMAL USE maintained BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE
A MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE provided when a support system or its parts impaired by wear have a TENSILE SAFETY FACTOR to values in Table 21 rows 5 and 6, but less than 3 and 4
MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE designed based on TOTAL LOAD and includes effects of SAFE WORKING LOAD when applicable
MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE has TENSILE SAFETY FACTORS for all parts not less than Table 21 row 7
MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE activated before travel (movement) produced an unacceptable RISK
MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE takes into account Clauses 9.2.5 and 9.8.4.3

Activation of MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE is made obvious to OPERATOR when ME EQUIPMENT can still be used after failure of suspension or actuation means and activation of MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE
MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE requires use of a TOOL to be reset or replaced
MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE intended to function once: further use of ME EQUIPMENT not possible until replacement of MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE

ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS instruct that once MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE is activated, SERVICE PERSONNEL shall be called and MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE must be replaced before ME EQUIPMENT can be used
ME EQUIPMENT permanently marked with safety sign 2 of Table D.2 (ISO 7010-W001)
Marking is adjacent to MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE or its location relative to MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE is obvious to service personnel

semantic_fragments.content: Compliance for static load requirements confirmed by examination of ME EQUIPMENT specifications of materials and their processing, and tests. PATIENT support/suspension system positioned horizontally in most disadvantageous position in NORMAL USE, and a mass 2 x 135 kg or twice intended persons load (the greater used) applied to foot support over an area of 0.1 m2 for 1 min. Acceptance: Damage or deflection greater than 5° from normal did not occur; BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE was maintained.

For sitting support/suspension: PATIENT support/suspension system set in most unfavourable NORMAL USE position, and a mass of 60% of part of SAFE WORKING LOAD simulating PATIENT or OPERATOR, or a minimum 80 kg, placed on support or suspension system with centre of load 60 mm from outer edge of support or suspension system for at least 1 min. Acceptance: Deflection of support/suspension from normal greater than 5° did not occur, and BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE was maintained.

Dynamic force test (9.8.3.3): PATIENT support/suspension system set in most unfavourable NORMAL USE position, and a mass equal to SAFE WORKING LOAD simulating PATIENT or OPERATOR dropped from 150 mm above seat area on an area of support/suspension a PATIENT or OPERATOR can sit. BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE must be maintained.

Mechanical Protective Device requirements (9.8.4.1-9.8.4.3): A MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE must be provided when support system parts impaired by wear have TENSILE SAFETY FACTOR per Table 21 rows 5 and 6 but less than 3 and 4. The device must be designed based on TOTAL LOAD, have TENSILE SAFETY FACTORS not less than Table 21 row 7, activate before unacceptable RISK from travel/movement, and comply with Clauses 9.2.5 and 9.8.4.3. Activation must be obvious to the OPERATOR. The device requires a TOOL for reset or replacement and is intended to function once only.

Once MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE is activated: further use of ME EQUIPMENT not possible until replacement; ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS must instruct that SERVICE PERSONNEL shall be called and MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE must be replaced before ME EQUIPMENT can be used; ME EQUIPMENT must be permanently marked with safety sign ISO 7010-W001 (Table D.2, sign 2); marking must be adjacent to or with obvious relative location to MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE for service personnel.
